in_arabic.name: عهدة
in_arabic.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'احد', which means 'one'. Uhaidah refers to a sincere promise, commitment, or covenant. In the context of Islamic history, Uhaidah bint Ja'far is a renowned warrior-woman who fought alongside Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) during the Battle of Uhud.
